title: feat(plugin-detail): complete remaining roadmap features for detail page
body:
- [x] 1. **Auto-discover related lists from objectSchema reference fields** — Added `autoDiscoverRelated` prop to DetailViewSchema; when true, auto-generates related lists from lookup/master_detail reference fields in objectSchema
- [x] 2. **Tab layout (Details/Related/Activity) for detail page** — Added `autoTabs` prop; when true, organizes sections into Details tab, related lists into Related tab, and activities into Activity tab
- [x] 3. **Related list row-level Edit/Delete quick actions** — Added `onRowEdit`/`onRowDelete` callback props to RelatedList; renders Edit/Delete buttons per row with confirmation dialog for delete
- [x] 4. **Related list pagination, sorting, filtering** — Added `pageSize`, `sortable`, `filterable` props to RelatedList; includes client-side pagination controls, sort buttons, and text filter input
- [x] 5. **Collapsible section groups** — Added `SectionGroup` component and `sectionGroups` prop to DetailViewSchema for grouping multiple sections under a collapsible header
- [x] 6. **Header highlight area with key fields** — Added `HeaderHighlight` component and `highlightFields` prop to DetailViewSchema for a prominent key-field banner below the header
- [x] 7. Add i18n translation keys for new features (11 new keys)
- [x] 8. Add tests for all new features (36 new tests, all passing)
- [x] 9. Update ROADMAP.md to reflect completed items
- [x] 10. Code review and security checks (0 CodeQL alerts)
